+def validate_retained_candidate(retained, source, tag, source_files):
+    retained = Path(retained)
+    candidate_path = retained / "candidate.json"
+    candidate = document(candidate_path)
+    fields(candidate, ("schema", "source", "version", "platform", "images", "source_files", "artifacts",
+                       "pending", "prepare_run_id", "prepare_run_attempt"), "candidate")
+    require(type(candidate["schema"]) is int and candidate["schema"] == 1 and candidate["source"] == source
+            and candidate["version"] == tag and candidate["platform"] == "linux/amd64"
+            and candidate["source_files"] == source_files, "retained candidate source differs")
+    require(type(candidate["prepare_run_id"]) is int and candidate["prepare_run_id"] > 0
+            and type(candidate["prepare_run_attempt"]) is int and candidate["prepare_run_attempt"] > 0,
+            "retained candidate run is malformed")
+    check_inventory(retained, candidate["artifacts"], excluded=("candidate.json",))
+    require(candidate["pending"] == check_verify(retained / "verify.log"), "retained verification accounting differs")
+    image_map(candidate["images"])
+    require(document(retained / "compose.json") == compose(candidate["images"]), "retained Compose differs")
+    verify_source_archive(retained / "source.tar", source_files)
+    repro = document(retained / "reproducibility.json")
+    fields(repro, (*SERVICES, "arm64", "extension"), "reproducibility records")
+    for service in SERVICES:
+        info = inspect_oci(retained / "oci" / service, source)
+        require(candidate["images"][service].endswith("@" + info["digest"]), "retained image digest differs")
+        payload = image_payload(retained / "oci" / service, info, service)
+        compared = (["usr/local/bin/tor-health-publisher"] if service == "tor" else sorted(payload))
+        fields(repro[service], ("tier", "files"), service + " reproducibility")
+        require(repro[service]["tier"] == ("package-set-and-publisher-bytes" if service == "tor"
+                else "all-shipped-payload-bytes") and
+                repro[service]["files"] == {p: {"sha256": sha(payload[p][0]), "mode": oct(payload[p][1])}
+                                             for p in sorted(compared)}, "reproducibility record differs from shipped payload")
+        if service == "stargate-dp":
+            require(regular(retained / "stargate-proxy-linux-amd64", MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES)
+                    == payload["opt/stargate/stargate-proxy"][0], "released DP binary differs from image")
+        elif service == "stargate-control":
+            verify_control_archive(retained / "stargate-control.tar", payload)
+        elif service == "tor":
+            require(document(retained / "tor-packages.json") == tor_packages(payload),
+                    "Tor package report differs from retained image")
+    arm = regular(retained / "stargate-proxy-linux-arm64", MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES)
+    require(arm and repro["arm64"] == {"tier": "cross-build-only-no-runtime-acceptance", "sha256": sha(arm)},
+            "arm64 cross-build record differs")
+    sources = extension_sources(ROOT / "extension")
+    zip_path = retained / "stargate-extension.zip"
+    check_extension_zip(zip_path, sources)
+    require(repro["extension"] == {"tier": "pinned-two-run-byte-identity", "sha256": file_hash(zip_path)},
+            "extension reproducibility record differs")
+    extension = document(retained / "stargate-extension.zip.inputs.json")
+    fields(extension, ("schema", "environment", "recipe_sha256", "helper_image_id", "source_files",
+                       "output_sha256"), "extension inputs")
+    require(type(extension["schema"]) is int and extension["schema"] == 1 and
+            extension["environment"] == pins()["extension"] and
+            extension["recipe_sha256"] == sha(regular(ROOT / "scripts/release/extension.Dockerfile")) and
+            isinstance(extension["helper_image_id"], str) and
+            re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", extension["helper_image_id"]) and
+            extension["source_files"] == {p: sha(data) for p, data in sources.items()} and
+            extension["output_sha256"] == file_hash(zip_path), "extension input/output record differs")
+    return candidate

+def candidate_pack(args, directory):
+    workflow_identity(args.source, args.version)
+    source_files = source_identity(args.source, args.version)
+    require(api("/commits/" + args.version).get("sha") == args.source, "remote source tag changed")
+    reject_existing_version(args.version)
+    policy = protection()
+    metadata = retained_metadata(args)
+    archive = directory / "artifact.zip"
+    require_space(directory, metadata["size_in_bytes"])
+    download(API + "/actions/artifacts/" + str(args.artifact_id) + "/zip", archive, MAX_ARCHIVE,
+             token=os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"])
+    require(archive.stat().st_size == metadata["size_in_bytes"], "retained archive length differs")
+    retained = directory / "retained"
+    extract_artifact(archive, metadata["digest"][7:], retained)
+    archive.unlink()
+    candidate_path = retained / "candidate.json"
+    candidate = validate_retained_candidate(retained, args.source, args.version, source_files)
+    require(candidate["prepare_run_id"] == args.prepare_run_id and candidate["prepare_run_attempt"] == args.prepare_run_attempt,
+            "retained candidate run differs")
+    evidence = directory / "evidence"
+    fetch_evidence(args.evidence_commit, args.version, evidence)
+    evidence_hash = check_evidence(candidate_path, evidence)
+    pack = {"schema": 1, "source": args.source, "version": args.version, "evidence_commit": args.evidence_commit,
+            "artifact_id": args.artifact_id, "prepare_run_id": args.prepare_run_id, "prepare_run_attempt": args.prepare_run_attempt,
+            "candidate_sha256": file_hash(candidate_path), "archive": metadata, "evidence_sha256": evidence_hash,
+            "protection": policy, "inputs_sha256": file_hash(ROOT / "scripts/release/inputs.json")}
+    return pack, retained, evidence
+
+
+def signature_flags(source, tag):
+    return ["--trusted-root", tool("trusted-root"), "--certificate-identity", "https://github.com/" + REPOSITORY
+            + "/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/" + tag,
+            "--certificate-oidc-issuer", "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com",
+            "--certificate-github-workflow-repository", REPOSITORY,
+            "--certificate-github-workflow-ref", "refs/tags/" + tag,
+            "--certificate-github-workflow-sha", source,
+            "--certificate-github-workflow-trigger", "workflow_dispatch"]
+
+
+def archive_directory(directory, output):
+    with tarfile.open(output, "w", format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as tf:
+        for path in sorted(Path(directory).rglob("*")):
+            require(not path.is_symlink(), "archive input contains symlink")
+            if path.is_dir():
+                continue
+            require(stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), "archive input contains special file")
+            member = tarfile.TarInfo(path.relative_to(directory).as_posix())
+            member.size = path.stat().st_size
+            member.mode, member.mtime = 0o644, 0
+            with path.open("rb") as stream:
+                tf.addfile(member, stream)
+
+
+def upload_asset(release_id, path):
+    require(type(release_id) is int and release_id > 0, "invalid release ID")
+    require(path.stat().st_size <= 2 * 1024**3, "release asset exceeds GitHub size limit")
+    url = "https://uploads.github.com/repos/" + REPOSITORY + "/releases/" + str(release_id) + "/assets?name=" + urllib.parse.quote(path.name, safe="")
+    # urllib streams a file object with the declared Content-Length; neither a
+    # token in argv nor an unbounded in-memory OCI archive is needed.
+    with path.open("rb") as data:
+        request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method="POST", headers={
+            "Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"], "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
+            "Content-Length": str(path.stat().st_size), "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28"})
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
+            result = decode(response.read(MAX_JSON + 1))
+    require(result.get("state") == "uploaded" and result.get("size") == path.stat().st_size
+            and result.get("digest") == "sha256:" + file_hash(path), "uploaded release asset identity differs")
+
+
+def promote(args):
+    workflow_identity(args.source, args.version)
+    require(os.environ.get("ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN") and os.environ.get("ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL"),
+            "promotion requires separate GitHub OIDC authority")
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stargate-promotion-") as temporary:
+        directory = Path(temporary)
+        pack, retained, evidence = candidate_pack(args, directory)
+        require(sha(canonical(pack)) == digest(args.pack_sha256), "protected job reconstructed a different approval pack")
+        require(protection(pack, approved=True) == pack["protection"], "protected environment policy changed after pack review")
+        require(api("/commits/" + args.version).get("sha") == args.source, "remote source tag changed")
+        reject_existing_version(args.version)
+        reject_existing_draft_or_release(args.version)
+        cosign, crane = tool("cosign"), tool("crane")
+        candidate = document(retained / "candidate.json")
+        publication = directory / "publication"
+        publication.mkdir()
+        docker_config = directory / "credentials"
+        docker_config.mkdir(mode=0o700)
+        auth = base64.b64encode((os.environ["GITHUB_ACTOR"] + ":" + os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]).encode()).decode()
+        write_json(docker_config / "config.json", {"auths": {"ghcr.io": {"auth": auth}}})
+        (docker_config / "config.json").chmod(0o600)
+        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("COSIGN_", "SIGSTORE_", "DOCKER_"))}
+        env["DOCKER_CONFIG"] = str(docker_config)
+        signing_config = directory / "signing-config.json"
+        write_json(signing_config, checked_signing_config())
+        signing_config.chmod(0o600)
+        signing = ["--yes", "--signing-config", signing_config, "--oidc-provider", "github-actions",
+                   "--trusted-root", tool("trusted-root")]
+        verification = signature_flags(args.source, args.version)
+        for service in SERVICES:
+            reference = candidate["images"][service]
+            # crane's default follows the sole layout descriptor, including
+            # the inner attestation index; --index would publish a different
+            # outer layout object (selected crane source, T081 grounding).
+            run([crane, "push", retained / "oci" / service, reference], env=env)
+            require(run([crane, "digest", reference], env=env).decode().strip() == reference.split("@")[1],
+                    "registry did not preserve retained OCI digest")
+            bundle = publication / (service + ".sigstore.json")
+            run([cosign, "sign", *signing, "--bundle", bundle, reference], env=env)
+            run([cosign, "verify", *verification, reference], env=env)
+            size = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in (retained / "oci" / service).rglob("*") if p.is_file())
+            count = sum(1 for p in (retained / "oci" / service).rglob("*") if p.is_file())
+            require_space(publication, size + count * 2048 + 10240)
+            archive_directory(retained / "oci" / service, publication / ("oci-" + service + ".tar"))
+            shutil.rmtree(retained / "oci" / service)
+        for name in ("compose.json", "candidate.json", "stargate-proxy-linux-amd64", "stargate-proxy-linux-arm64",
+                     "stargate-control.tar", "stargate-extension.zip", "stargate-extension.zip.inputs.json",
+                     "source.tar", "verify.log", "reproducibility.json", "tor-packages.json"):
+            shutil.move(retained / name, publication / name)
+        archive_directory(retained / "logs", publication / "build-logs.tar")
+        archive_directory(evidence, publication / "evidence.tar")
+        write_json(publication / "approval-pack.json", pack)
+        manifest = {"schema": 1, "version": args.version, "source": args.source, "platform": "linux/amd64",
+                    "images": candidate["images"], "compose_sha256": file_hash(publication / "compose.json"),
+                    "source_files": candidate["source_files"], "artifacts": inventory(publication),
+                    "pack_sha256": args.pack_sha256}
+        manifest_path = publication / "release.json"
+        write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
+        bundle = publication / "release.sigstore.json"
+        run([cosign, "sign-blob", *signing, "--bundle", bundle, manifest_path], env=env)
+        run([cosign, "verify-blob", "--bundle", bundle, *verification, manifest_path], env=env)
+        # A failed upload may leave immutable GHCR objects or an unpublished
+        # draft. Only this final verified manifest/release advances install.
+        fresh_trust()
+        require(protection(pack, approved=True) == pack["protection"], "approval policy changed during publication")
+        require(api("/commits/" + args.version).get("sha") == args.source, "source tag changed during publication")
+        reject_existing_draft_or_release(args.version)
+        release = api("/releases", method="POST", data={"tag_name": args.version, "target_commitish": args.source,
+                      "name": "Stargate " + args.version, "draft": True, "prerelease": False,
+                      "body": "Source " + args.source + ". Approval pack SHA256 " + args.pack_sha256
+                      + ". Verify release.json and its Sigstore bundle before installation; see docs/releasing.md at that source."})
+        require(release.get("draft") is True, "release staging did not create a draft")
+        for path in sorted(publication.iterdir()):
+            upload_asset(release["id"], path)
+        require(api("/commits/" + args.version).get("sha") == args.source, "source tag changed before finalization")
+        api("/releases/" + str(release["id"]), method="PATCH", data={"draft": False, "make_latest": "false"})
+
+
+def promotion_pack(args):
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stargate-pack-") as temporary:
+        pack, _, _ = candidate_pack(args, Path(temporary))
+        write_json(args.output, pack)
+        checksum = sha(canonical(pack))
+        summary = ("Review the complete retained candidate and immutable evidence commit before approving.\n\n"
+                   + "Required approval comment:\n\n" + approval_comment(pack) + "\n")
+        if os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"):
+            with open(os.environ["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"], "a") as stream:
+                stream.write(summary)
+        if os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"):
+            with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as stream:
+                stream.write("pack_sha256=" + checksum + "\n")
+        print(summary)
+
+
+def extension_sources(directory):
+    result = {}
+    total = 0
+    for path in sorted(Path(directory).rglob("*")):
+        relative = path.relative_to(directory).as_posix()
+        if relative == "dist" or relative.startswith("dist/"):
+            continue
+        require(not path.is_symlink(), "extension source contains a symlink")
+        if path.is_dir():
+            continue
+        require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+", relative), "unsupported extension filename")
+        data = regular(path, MAX_JSON)
+        total += len(data)
+        require(total <= 32 * 1024**2, "extension source exceeds bound")
+        result[relative] = data
+    require("package.sh" in result and "manifest.json" in result, "extension source is incomplete")
+    return result
+
+
+def check_extension_zip(path, sources):
+    expected = {name: data for name, data in sources.items()
+                if PurePosixPath(name).name not in ("package.sh", ".keep")}
+    require(Path(path).stat().st_size <= 64 * 1024**2, "extension archive exceeds bound")
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
+        require(z.namelist() == sorted(expected), "extension archive member set/order differs")
+        for info in z.infolist():
+            require(info.create_system == 3 and info.external_attr >> 16 == 0o100644 and not info.extra
+                    and info.date_time == (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "extension archive metadata is not canonical")
+            require(info.file_size == len(expected[info.filename]) and z.read(info) == expected[info.filename],
+                    "extension archive source bytes differ")
+
+
+def package_extension(args):
+    sources = extension_sources(ROOT / "extension")
+    require(extension_sources(args.source_dir) == sources, "packaging source differs from reviewed extension")
+    require(not args.output.exists() and not Path(str(args.output) + ".inputs.json").exists(), "packaging output already exists")
+    inputs = pins()["extension"]
+    recipe = ROOT / "scripts/release/extension.Dockerfile"
+    recipe_data = regular(recipe)
+    require(inputs["platform"] == "linux/amd64" and inputs["base"].encode() in recipe_data
+            and inputs["inrelease_sha256"].encode() in recipe_data, "archive recipe differs from selected environment")
+    for name, record in inputs["packages"].items():
+        require((name + "=" + record["version"]).encode() in recipe_data and record["package_sha256"].encode() in recipe_data
+                and record["file_sha256"].encode() in recipe_data, "archive recipe package pin differs")
+    buildx = tool("docker-buildx")
+    require_space(args.output.parent, sum(map(len, sources.values())) * 3)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stargate-zip-") as temporary:
+        directory = Path(temporary)
+        snapshot = directory / "source"
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        for name, data in sources.items():
+            path = snapshot / name
+            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            path.write_bytes(data)
+        tag = "stargate-release-zip:" + sha(str(directory).encode())[:24]
+        metadata = directory / "build.json"
+        try:
+            run([buildx, "build", "--no-cache", "--platform", "linux/amd64", "--file", recipe,
+                 "--load", "--tag", tag, "--metadata-file", metadata, "."], timeout=1200)
+            image_id = document(metadata).get("containerimage.config.digest", "")
+            require(re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", image_id), "archive helper image identity missing")
+            require(run(["docker", "image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Id}}", tag]).decode().strip() == image_id,
+                    "loaded archive helper differs from build")
+            hardened = ["docker", "run", "--rm", "--network", "none", "--read-only", "--cap-drop", "ALL",
+                        "--security-opt", "no-new-privileges", "--user", str(os.getuid()) + ":" + str(os.getgid())]
+            files = [record["file"] for record in inputs["packages"].values()]
+            tool_rows = run([*hardened, image_id, "sha256sum", *files]).decode().splitlines()
+            require(tool_rows == [record["file_sha256"] + "  " + record["file"] for record in inputs["packages"].values()],
+                    "archive tool/library bytes differ")
+            run([*hardened, "--tmpfs", "/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777",
+                 "--mount", "type=bind,src=" + str(snapshot) + ",dst=/source", image_id, "bash", "/source/package.sh"], timeout=120)
+            output = snapshot / "dist/stargate-extension.zip"
+            check_extension_zip(output, sources)
+            args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            shutil.copyfile(output, args.output)
+            write_json(Path(str(args.output) + ".inputs.json"), {"schema": 1, "environment": inputs,
+                       "recipe_sha256": sha(recipe_data), "helper_image_id": image_id,
+                       "source_files": {name: sha(data) for name, data in sources.items()},
+                       "output_sha256": file_hash(args.output)})
+        finally:
+            # Remove only the tag this invocation assigned, never all tags of
+            # a potentially shared content ID or host-global image/cache state.
+            primary_failure = sys.exc_info()[0] is not None
+            try:
+                run(["docker", "image", "rm", tag])
+            except (Refusal, OSError):
+                # A failed build need not have created its tag. Preserve its
+                # diagnostic; a cleanup failure after success is still fatal.
+                if not primary_failure:
+                    raise
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("compose")
+    p.add_argument("--images", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("verify-install")
+    p.add_argument("--release-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    p = commands.add_parser("check-evidence")
+    p.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--evidence-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("check-policy")
+    p.add_argument("--pack", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--approved", action="store_true")
+    p = commands.add_parser("extract-artifact")
+    p.add_argument("--archive", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("install-tools")
+    p.add_argument("--purpose", choices=("prepare", "validate", "promote", "install"), required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("check-verify")
+    p.add_argument("--log", type=Path, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("inspect-oci")
+    p.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--source", required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("prepare")
+    p.add_argument("--source", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--version", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("package-extension")
+    p.add_argument("--source-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "extension")
+    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("check-retained")
+    p.add_argument("--source", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--version", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--artifact-id", type=int, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--prepare-run-id", type=int, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--prepare-run-attempt", type=int, required=True)
+    p = commands.add_parser("verify-candidate")
+    p.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--source", required=True)
+    p.add_argument("--version", required=True)
+    for name in ("promotion-pack", "promote"):
+        p = commands.add_parser(name)
+        p.add_argument("--source", required=True)
+        p.add_argument("--version", required=True)
+        p.add_argument("--evidence-commit", required=True)
+        p.add_argument("--artifact-id", type=int, required=True)
+        p.add_argument("--prepare-run-id", type=int, required=True)
+        p.add_argument("--prepare-run-attempt", type=int, required=True)
+        if name == "promotion-pack":
+            p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+        else:
+            p.add_argument("--pack-sha256", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.command == "compose":
+        write_json(args.output, compose(document(args.images)))
+    elif args.command == "verify-install":
+        print(verify_install(args.release_dir, args.output))
+    elif args.command == "check-evidence":
+        print(check_evidence(args.candidate, args.evidence_dir))
+    elif args.command == "check-policy":
+        print(canonical(protection(document(args.pack), args.approved)).decode(), end="")
+    elif args.command == "extract-artifact":
+        extract_artifact(args.archive, args.sha256, args.output)
+    elif args.command == "install-tools":
+        install_tools(args.purpose)
+    elif args.command == "check-verify":
+        print(canonical(check_verify(args.log)).decode(), end="")
+    elif args.command == "inspect-oci":
+        print(canonical(inspect_oci(args.directory, args.source)).decode(), end="")
+    elif args.command == "prepare":
+        prepare(args)
+    elif args.command == "package-extension":
+        package_extension(args)
+    elif args.command == "check-retained":
+        print(canonical(retained_metadata(args)).decode(), end="")
+    elif args.command == "verify-candidate":
+        print(canonical(validate_retained_candidate(args.directory, args.source, args.version,
+                                                   source_identity(args.source, args.version))).decode(), end="")
+    elif args.command == "promotion-pack":
+        promotion_pack(args)
+    elif args.command == "promote":
+        promote(args)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except (Refusal, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, tarfile.TarError, zipfile.BadZipFile, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
+        print("release: refusing: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)

+# Copyright 2026 The Stargate Authors
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# Keep outside extension/: package.sh intentionally archives its source tree.
+FROM debian:12-slim@sha256:60eac759739651111db372c07be67863818726f754804b8707c90979bda511df
+
+# HTTP transports signed metadata, not authority. The base's pinned Debian
+# keyring must authenticate this exact InRelease; no unsigned/expiry bypass.
+# dpkg installs only the checked local debs; audit refuses incomplete dependency
+# configuration without asking the apt resolver to fetch another archive.
+RUN test "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" = amd64 \
+ && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list \
+ && rm -rf /etc/apt/sources.list.d \
+ && mkdir /etc/apt/sources.list.d \
+ && printf '%s\n' 'deb http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/20260714T082229Z/ bookworm main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/snapshot.list \
+ && apt-get update \
+ && printf '%s\n' '77737fa4b34f2693e982cc9ee35736816c35a7778fc2d326cc1bbf5b301fe1aa  /var/lib/apt/lists/snapshot.debian.org_archive_debian_20260714T082229Z_dists_bookworm_InRelease' | sha256sum -c - \
+ && mkdir /tmp/packages \
+ && cd /tmp/packages \
+ && apt-get download zip=3.0-13 libbz2-1.0=1.0.8-5+b1 \
+ && printf '%s\n' \
+      '8877a360e455c7b9b6d448503eeaacc6b9a1325b548f3fb7eef69a87ab558b96  zip_3.0-13_amd64.deb' \
+      '54149da3f44b22d523b26b692033b84503d822cc5122fed606ea69cc83ca5aeb  libbz2-1.0_1.0.8-5+b1_amd64.deb' | sha256sum -c - \
+ && dpkg -i ./libbz2-1.0_1.0.8-5+b1_amd64.deb ./zip_3.0-13_amd64.deb \
+ && dpkg --audit \
+ && printf '%s\n' \
+      'f718b59a4b1a647d2a9ce52fdec4011b626f581d5fd34ba598aae333611600ce  /usr/bin/zip' \
+      'e4f501c8bd22390e42422691093d8af4e744a3e854809b809948055e8b08bda5  /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libbz2.so.1.0.4' | sha256sum -c - \
+ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /tmp/packages
+
+WORKDIR /source

+def source_shape():
+    # A deliberately narrow recording-parser fixture for THIS source YAML, not
+    # a production YAML parser. Every current field feeds the topology assertions.
+    lines = []
+    for line in (ROOT / "compose/docker-compose.local.yml").read_text().splitlines():
+        if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
+            lines.append((len(line) - len(line.lstrip()), line.strip()))
+
+    def scalar(s):
+        if s in ("true", "false") or s.isdigit() or s.startswith('"'):
+            return json.loads(s)
+        return s
+
+    def block(i, indent):
+        result = [] if lines[i][1].startswith("- ") else {}
+        while i < len(lines) and lines[i][0] == indent:
+            text = lines[i][1]
+            i += 1
+            if isinstance(result, list):
+                if not text.startswith("- "):
+                    raise AssertionError("fixture parser needs updating")
+                result.append(scalar(text[2:]))
+            else:
+                key, value = text.split(":", 1)
+                if value.strip():
+                    result[key] = scalar(value.strip())
+                elif i < len(lines) and lines[i][0] > indent:
+                    result[key], i = block(i, lines[i][0])
+                else:
+                    result[key] = None
+        return result, i
+
+    obj, end = block(0, 0)
+    assert end == len(lines)
+    return obj

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright 2026 The Stargate Authors
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# T081 / Principle VI: compare the observer executable from two cold builds.
+# Image config timestamps are outside this byte reproducibility claim.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
+dockerfile=sidecars/tor-observer/Dockerfile
+if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo 'SKIP: Docker unavailable for observer reproducibility' >&2
+  exit 0
+fi
+builder="$(sed -nE 's/^FROM ([^[:space:]]+).* AS builder$/\1/p' "$dockerfile")"
+if [[ "$builder" != *@sha256:* ]]; then
+  echo 'FAIL: observer builder is not digest-pinned' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+work="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/stargate-t081-observer.XXXXXXXX")"
+id="${work##*.}"
+tags=("stargate-t081-observer:$id-one" "stargate-t081-observer:$id-two")
+containers=()
+cleanup() {
+  local result=$?
+  trap - EXIT
+  if [ "${#containers[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
+    docker rm -f "${containers[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  docker image rm "${tags[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  rm -rf -- "$work"
+  exit "$result"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+for ordinal in 0 1; do
+  docker build --no-cache --target builder --file "$dockerfile" --tag "${tags[$ordinal]}" . \
+    || { echo "FAIL: observer cold build $((ordinal + 1))" >&2; exit 1; }
+  container="$(docker create "${tags[$ordinal]}")" \
+    || { echo 'FAIL: cannot create observer builder container' >&2; exit 1; }
+  [ -n "$container" ] || { echo 'FAIL: empty builder container ID' >&2; exit 1; }
+  containers+=("$container")
+  docker cp "$container:/out/tor-observer" "$work/observer-$ordinal" \
+    || { echo 'FAIL: cannot extract observer binary' >&2; exit 1; }
+  [ -s "$work/observer-$ordinal" ] || { echo 'FAIL: empty observer binary' >&2; exit 1; }
+  docker rm "$container" >/dev/null
+  containers=()
+done
+
+if ! cmp -s "$work/observer-0" "$work/observer-1"; then
+  echo 'FAIL: two independent observer executable outputs differ' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+printf 'PASS: observer executable byte-identical across two cold builds (sha256:%s)\n' \
+  "$(sha256sum "$work/observer-0" | cut -d' ' -f1)"

+finite real validation completes.
+

+recipe, selected base/snapshot, zip/libbz2 bytes and candidate ZIP identity in
+the retained input report. A mismatch in the release mode's ZIP is a defect;
+do not normalize it away as host-tool variance.

+## Tor observer (`sidecars/tor-observer/`)

+The release-cadence `tor_observer_test.sh` compares the actual

+The T081 preparation also compares the executable bytes extracted from both
+retained OCI runs, and the first payload supplies the released image. Image
+config/layer timestamps are not an accepted executable-byte difference or a
+claim that complete OCI images are byte-identical.

+## 2026-10-11 — Exhaust release-list pagination before protected promotion (T081 review round 4)
+
+**Accepted Major finding and mitigation.** The draft-aware list guard previously
+validated only `next` links; a `last=2` link without `next` could falsely mark
+page 1 complete. It also accepted a full 100-item page without a Link header
+without checking whether page 2 existed. Both paths could miss a later draft and
+permit registry pushes and signing. The guard now validates every supplied Link
+relation and rejects contradictory, foreign, malformed, duplicate or out-of-bound
+pages. A full page with no Link triggers one bounded next-page query; an empty
+page completes the traversal, and a later draft or unreadable page refuses before
+mutation. An ordinary short or empty single page without Link remains valid
+(THREAT-MODEL §3.5; `scripts/release.py` and release transport fixtures).
+
+**Phase correction.** Tokenless preparation has no release API check or publication
+authority. The read-only approval pack checks published releases; protected
+promotion is the authoritative draft-visible reuse gate. No token is injected
+into preparation's build/tool subprocess environment.
+
+## 2026-10-11 — Draft-aware version reuse refusal in protected promotion (T081 review round 3)
+
+**Accepted Major finding and mitigation.** `GET /releases/tags/{tag}` reports
+published releases, so its 404 did not establish that a failed upload had left
+no unpublished draft. A retry could push images and sign again before learning
+that the version was claimed. The read-only approval-pack phase retains that
+early published-release check; tokenless preparation has no release API check.
+Before the first registry push, protected promotion now verifies its
+token's push access for the canonical repository and traverses the bounded
+draft-visible release list, validating response shape and pagination links. It
+repeats the check immediately before creating the draft. A matching published
+release or draft, missing push proof, inaccessible list or incomplete traversal
+refuses. GitHub's list-releases API documents draft visibility for principals
+with push access; its pagination API documents the Link header as the source of
+next-page URLs. The transport fixtures cover a hidden draft after a published
+lookup 404, a later-page draft and failed visibility (THREAT-MODEL §3.5).
+
+**Residual trust.** The API's authenticated permission report and release list
+remain trusted. Concurrent administrator changes and cross-repository atomicity
+are outside the existing guarantee; retries do not delete or reuse drafts.
+
+## 2026-10-11 — Refuse redirected Docker daemons before local init policy (T081 review round 2)
+
+**Accepted Major finding and mitigation.** Source and signed-release init imposed
+host-boundary policy on the invoking machine, but Docker could select a remote
+daemon through DOCKER_HOST, DOCKER_CONTEXT or a stored currentContext. The local
+policy would then protect the wrong host while Compose started the data plane
+elsewhere. This violated the local deployment claim under Constitution III and
+THREAT-MODEL §3.5. The common init preflight now requires Docker's effective
+selected context to be `default`, its resolved daemon endpoint to be the local
+rootful `/var/run/docker.sock` or `/run/docker.sock`, and its security options to
+exclude rootless. Missing, malformed, redirected or alternate-socket responses
+refuse before host policy, volumes, keys or containers mutate. Both init modes use
+the same guard; the T081 release init fixture tests refusals in each mode, and the
+existing T106 count-probe fixture retains its original fail-closed assertion.
+
+**Residual trust.** The local Docker CLI, daemon and socket identity remain trusted;
+a compromised local host can lie about daemon state or change host policy. This
+does not confer host isolation on remote Docker deployments. See THREAT-MODEL §3.1
+and §3.5 and `scripts/subcommands/init`.
+
+## 2026-10-11 — Immutable source and separately promoted release artifacts (T081)
+
+**Supersession.** The historical 2026-07-04 Tor rationale's instruction to append
+final image digests to this file/source Compose at tag time is superseded by this
+entry. Historical bodies remain unchanged. Reviewed source contains base/build
+input pins; final four runtime registry digests belong to generated release Compose
+and a signed manifest. No final artifact identity can rewrite its reviewed source
+or move the selected existing version tag (Constitution IV/VI; THREAT-MODEL §3.5).
+
+Preparation retains exact OCI bytes, source, input identities and reproducibility
+records with read-only grants. Promotion retrieves the same immutable artifact ID,
+validates detached evidence from fixed paths at a same-repository commit as data,
+and requires the protected stargate-release environment's non-self approval of the
+exact pack. Registry GITHUB_TOKEN authority and OIDC signing authority are distinct.
+A deployment click cannot replace the external-human review required by VIII.
+
+Only the verified full-source init path may admit generated Compose; it retains the
+mandatory local host policy and authenticated readiness and never builds release
+images. Failed validation refuses before provisioning. Failed cross-repository
+uploads can leave immutable remote objects; publishing the verified signed manifest
+is the commit point. Uploads are not transactionally atomic across repositories.
+
+This is a reviewed-source contract and implementation target, not a published-release,
+apt/signature-validation or live-acceptance claim. The source-owned Sigstore selection
+records the audited metadata chain and a conservative new-promotion freshness cutoff;
+the HTTPS bootstrap assumption and offline revocation limits remain explicit.

+# Preparing and promoting a release
+
+Copyright 2026 The Stargate Authors. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+The release workflow operates on an **existing reviewed version tag** and its exact
+source commit C. Preparation does not publish, sign, create a tag or rewrite source.
+Promotion consumes retained bytes and independent evidence; it never rebuilds.
+Acceptance of T081's workflow implementation is not release authorization or a
+claim that final review, real signatures, live tests or publication have occurred.
+
+## Source and artifact boundary
+
+Source Compose remains the development build entry point. Release Compose is a
+generated JSON Compose document with exactly `stargate-dp`, `stargate-control`,
+`tor` and `tor-observer`. Each image names a GHCR repository and registry digest;
+build entries and `pull_policy: build` are removed. All other parsed source
+topology is retained. A relative host bind mount requires an explicit future
+implementation; it cannot silently change meaning in the release directory.
+
+Feature 001 packages Linux amd64 Local images, amd64 and arm64 data-plane
+binaries, the complete JVM fast-jar tree (including its launcher, app/lib/quarkus
+directories and entrypoint), the extension ZIP and full source. Arm64 is a
+cross-build comparison, **not runtime acceptance**. Native CP and additional
+runtime profiles are not produced by this workflow. This packaging scope does
+not discharge any live release obligation: R-1 through R-8, including R-7's
+routed IPv6, LAN/VPS, physical NIC and hypervisor observations, remain required.
+Unsupported or unmeasured scope blocks promotion; it is never N/A or PASS. R-2
+cannot substitute for R-3 or R-7. The exact tracker text at C governs each report.
+
+## Preparation
+
+Dispatch `.github/workflows/release.yml` on the existing version tag with
+`phase=prepare`, `version=vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` and the full 40-character `source=C`.
+The selected workflow ref, workflow SHA, checkout HEAD and existing tag must all
+agree. A branch dispatch or a mismatched source is not a preparation job.
+
+Preparation uses a fresh `ubuntu-24.04` hosted job, with a 240-minute timeout.
+That timeout is not measured runtime or capacity. Disk feasibility for the full
+verifier, cold image builds, comparisons and retained artifact must be evaluated;
+neither the artifact limits nor the workflow label establish sufficient capacity.
+This task registers no runner and changes no host. Docker, its daemon and the
+existing verifier's system prerequisites must work.
+Source and release init accept only the default Docker context at the local
+rootful `/var/run/docker.sock` or `/run/docker.sock`; a remote context, redirected
+socket or rootless daemon refuses before host policy or provisioning.
+The pinned setup action supplies Go, JDK, Python and Node. An absent required
+tool is a refusal, not a release PASS. Actual resource needs/tool interoperability
+must be measured in an explicitly authorized finite validation before use.
+
+`scripts/release/inputs.json` identifies the selected Compose, Buildx, BuildKit,
+SBOM generator, Crane, Cosign, Sigstore root bytes and fixed signing services. `install-tools` downloads
+only the fixed public URLs and verifies lengths and SHA256 before installation.
+Every execution rechecks the installed tool. For Crane, the verified upstream
+archive is retained and its member is compared directly; a local receipt does
+not replace the archive's pin. Tools live under `target/release-tools` and do
+not replace host tools. Publisher metadata grounding does not prove runtime
+compatibility of those exact binary bytes.
+
+Preparation has only contents/read and actions/read grants. It refuses ambient
+OIDC authority and verification narrowing. It runs the full `scripts/verify.sh`
+with `STARGATE_GROUND_ONLINE=1` and `STARGATE_VERIFY_REPRO=1`. The log must contain
+every expected gate. A package-level PASS cannot hide individual test skips.
+The verifier uses a positively identified local Docker driver: its tagged test
+images must load into the daemon, and Tor's host-network rollback build must
+reach its loopback replay proxy. The separate source-pinned container builder
+is used for retained OCI exports after that verifier; it is not selected for
+the verifier's daemon-consumed tests. An unreachable proxy remains a failed
+rollback control, not evidence of hash rejection.
+No-test Go packages are distinguished from skipped tests using the source tree.
+Only the driver's fixed, named cadence cases may remain pending; the candidate
+records them explicitly and promotion requires their corresponding live/full
+cadence reports. Missing prerequisites and arbitrary skip reasons are not waivers.
+
+Four amd64 OCI layouts retain every index, manifest, config, layer, SBOM and
+provenance blob. Their actual selected registry object is the sole outer-layout
+descriptor, often an inner image/attestation index. Neither a Docker image ID nor
+the outer layout's JSON hash is substituted for that digest. The OCI manifest
+subject and index annotation both bind each
+attestation to the runtime manifest; BuildKit's inner SPDX/SLSA statements may
+have empty subject arrays while those hashed graph links remain exact.
+Two cold builds
+compare shipped DP/observer bytes and the entire JVM payload. Tor compares the
+source-locked installed package set and publisher bytes, not whole-image digests.
+The final binaries/JVM archive come from those retained image payloads. Full
+verifier reproducibility tests remain separate required comparisons, including
+the cross-host JVM test. Preparation also packages the delivered extension ZIP
+twice with separately built, no-cache pinned helpers and records their identical
+SHA256 alongside the helper image, recipe, package and source inputs. The
+protected job checks the extension ZIP and its input/output record against C.
+See [BUILD-DIFFS.md](../BUILD-DIFFS.md).
+
+Retain the action's artifact ID, archive SHA256, run ID and run attempt. The
+artifact name includes C and these identities but is not a lookup authority.
+Retention is 14 days; a lost or expired artifact requires a new preparation and
+new evidence bindings. Promotion never repairs an artifact by rebuilding it.
+Git path filtering authenticates checkout files against C; the source manifest
+hashes the delivered checkout/archive bytes. This matters for tracked files
+whose `.gitattributes` require CRLF on disk and in `git archive`.
+
+## Detached evidence E
+
+Store evidence at `release-evidence/<version>/` in a separate immutable commit E
+in the **same repository**. E may follow C. Do not change C or move its tag to
+include reports about artifacts produced from C. The driver fetches fixed Git
+trees/blobs as data, verifies Git blob identities and SHA256, and never checks
+out E or runs its code. Files must be flat, regular, non-executable blobs: at
+most 128 files, 8 MiB per report and 64 MiB total.
+
+`index.json` has exactly `schema: 1`, `source`, `version`, `candidate_sha256` and
+`files`. `candidate_sha256` hashes the exact retained `candidate.json` bytes.
+`files` maps every other evidence filename to its `sha256` and byte `size`.
+Duplicate keys, unsafe paths, missing or extra bytes refuse. JSON hashes use the
+actual file bytes; generated canonical JSON uses sorted keys, compact separators
+and one trailing newline.
+
+Required report metadata:
+
+| File | Required fields |
+| --- | --- |
+| `T078.json`, `T079.json`, `external-human.json` | `schema: 1`, exact `source`, `status: "PASS"`, `reviewer`, UTC `observed_at`, `report` filename, `independent: true`, boolean `human` (true for external-human) |
+| `live.json` | `schema: 1`, exact `source` and `version`, `tracker_sha256`, `observations` |
+| `cadence.json`, when candidate has pending named Go suites | `schema: 1`, exact `source`, `artifact_sha256`, `results` |
+
+Every `report` names an included, nonempty full text report, not just a status or
+URL. T078/T079 bind C and include the actual final findings/dispositions and
+reviewer provenance. The external-human report is a separate Constitution VIII
+review; a deployment approval click is not that review. The metadata's reviewer,
+independence and human fields are assertions to inspect, not authenticated identities.
+
+`live.json` hashes `specs/001-tor-route/live-e2e/README.md` at C and contains exactly
+F1–F5, F7 and R-1–R-8. F6 is the retained actual verifier run. Each observation has
+`status: "PASS"`, `scope: "exercised"`, its full `report`, `contract_sha256` of
+the exact tracker table row (UTF-8, without newline), and `artifact_sha256`
+mapping **all** candidate artifact names to their retained hashes. R-7 additionally
+has `coverage` with `routed-ipv6`, `lan`, `vps`, `physical-nic`, `hypervisor`, all
+PASS. Include methods, environment/snapshot, complete results, positive controls,
+limits and raw-evidence provenance in the reports. Identifiers and hashes alone
+do not prove that these observations occurred or covered their contracts.
+
+When `cadence.json` is required, its artifact map is the same complete map. Its
+`results` keys are exactly the candidate's pending Go suite names; each value has
+`status: "PASS"` and a full `report`. The report must show that the named suite
+actually ran, without skipped individual cases, on the identified candidate.
+No report supplies commands to execute, credential destinations or skip policy.
+
+## Protected promotion
+
+Before any promotion, a maintainer must configure environment `stargate-release`
+with required reviewers, prevent-self-review enabled, administrator bypass
+disabled, and exactly one custom deployment policy: **tag `v*`**. The initial
+implementation requires at least one configured direct User reviewer; it does
+not infer team membership. A read-only API check must be able to observe all
+these properties. Missing, inaccessible or omitted fields fail closed, including
+the bypass field. Naming an environment in YAML does not configure it. Do not
+add a long-lived administrator token to work around an unreadable policy.
+
+Dispatch the same workflow on the same tag with `phase=promote`, C, version,
+`evidence_commit=E`, `artifact_id`, `prepare_run_id` and `prepare_run_attempt`.
+The read-only `pack` job checks source, tag, successful preparation run, archive
+identity/expiry, safe extraction, every retained file, OCI graph, generated
+Compose, complete evidence and environment policy. Archive limits are 8 GiB
+compressed and 16 GiB extracted; traversal, links, duplicate entries and special
+files are refused. The job publishes the exact pack hash and required approval
+comment in its summary before the protected job starts.
+
+The reviewer must inspect C, the complete retained artifact and full E report
+bodies, establish actual reviewer/report provenance and substantive coverage,
+and approve **that pack** with the exact generated comment. The comment names
+pack SHA256, C, E, artifact ID and preparation run/attempt. Neither the invoking
+actor nor triggering actor may approve. Report JSON cannot authorize promotion.
+
+The protected job independently reconstructs the pack, rechecks policy and
+approval history, and compares the approved hash. GHCR uses a short-lived
+`GITHUB_TOKEN` with packages/write; Cosign separately obtains GitHub OIDC with
+id-token/write. Contents/write is used only for the final GitHub Release. The
+token is not put in command arguments or persisted beyond the job's private
+temporary Docker credential directory.
+
+Crane copies the already-validated OCI descriptor graph without rebuilding or
+reindexing. Cosign signs and verifies the exact registry digests and final
+manifest with the expected repository, tag, source SHA, workflow path, dispatch
+event and `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com` issuer. The source-owned
+Cosign v3 signing-config file names only Fulcio and one Rekor service, with a
+validity end matching the reviewed root's freshness cutoff. The protected job
+writes it under its private temporary directory; it does not let an automatically
+refreshed signing configuration choose service URLs. A real keyless signing
+check remains necessary before claiming end-to-end compatibility.
+
+Only after digest/signature checks does the driver stage a draft release,
+upload and hash-check every asset, then publish it. A failed upload may leave
+immutable registry blobs, signatures or an unpublished draft. It does not
+publish a final manifest or advance a latest channel. Any existing version
+release/draft refuses; the read-only pack checks published releases, while
+protected promotion verifies push access and checks all draft-visible release
+pages before its first push and again before creating a draft. Tokenless
+preparation may retain candidate bytes for a version that later refuses, but
+has no publication authority. A maintainer must resolve an abandoned draft
+before retrying. Cross-repository uploads are not atomic,
+and concurrent malicious administrator/tag changes remain outside transactional
+guarantees. No remote workflow, runner, tag, protection setting or publication
+is performed merely by implementing or testing this workflow.
+
+The signed `release.json` inventories every published asset. Those assets
+include the complete retained OCI graphs, source archive, verifier log,
+reproducibility record, Tor package report, extension input/output record,
+build logs and full detached evidence E. The protected job validates the
+retained candidate against its source and image payloads before transforming
+the OCI directories and logs into publication archives.
+
+## Trust selection and expiry
+
+The source-owned Sigstore selection records root 15, targets 14, snapshot 166,
+timestamp 805 and the target hash/length. The 2026-10-11 audit checked threshold
+continuity from the HTTPS-selected historical root 5, current role signatures,
+version/hash/length binding and metadata expiry. HTTPS bootstrap trust is an
+explicit assumption; this is not a custom production TUF updater or independent
+initial root authentication. Cosign performs artifact crypto, certificate,
+transparency-log and signing-time validity checks.
+
+For **new promotion**, the selected metadata's earliest freshness cutoff is
+2026-10-18T01:48:18Z. At or after that instant, promotion refuses until a reviewed
+source update selects fresh authenticated metadata. Evidence, environment
+variables and CLI arguments cannot extend it. Preparation may still build bytes;
+it cannot turn stale trust selection into publication authority.
+
+Existing artifact installation does not expire at that cutoff: its signature's
+trusted signing time and Cosign verification govern validity. An offline static
+root cannot discover later compromise, revocation or rotation. Operators need
+reviewed trust/tool updates; no background updater, automatic repin, custom
+cryptography or insecure verification bypass is provided.
+
+## Installing released Local artifacts
+
+Use a clean Git checkout of the exact source C and existing version tag; this
+includes the installer, source Compose, host policy, input pins and verifier.
+The shipped `source.tar` is complete audit material, not a scripts-only installer
+and not a substitute for the checkout's Git identity checks. Download
+`release.json`, `release.sigstore.json` and `compose.json` into a data directory.
+Verify the release's source/tag out of band before running its source code.
+
+From that checkout, explicitly acquire the source-pinned verifier/parser tools:
+
+```sh
+python3 scripts/release.py install-tools --purpose install
+scripts/stargate init --release-dir /absolute/path/to/release-data
+```
+
+Tool retrieval is separate and operator-invoked. `init` itself does not download
+or execute code from the release directory. It checks actual source bytes and
+Git executable modes, HEAD/tag and clean state, then verifies the signed manifest
+and exact generated Compose before changing installer state. Signature inputs
+and validated Compose are privately snapshotted so later mutations of the input
+directory do not change what the installer uses. The ordinary mandatory host
+confinement, volume/key preservation and authenticated observer readiness remain
+in force. Startup uses `--no-build`; default `init` keeps source-build behavior.
+Compose/image/key-helper overrides conflict with release mode and are refused.
+
+Fixtures use recording tools and bounded transport data. Their green result
+does not establish actual apt/keyring acceptance, Compose/Buildx/OCI/Cosign
+interoperability, configured remote protection, live acceptance or publication.

+MAX_JSON = 8 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_ARCHIVE = 8 * 1024**3
+MAX_UNPACKED = 16 * 1024**3
+DISK_RESERVE = 1024**3
+MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT = 64 * 1024**2
+MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 512 * 1024**2
+
+
+class Refusal(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def require(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        raise Refusal(message)
+
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def canonical(value):
+    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def unique(pairs):
+    result = {}
+    for key, value in pairs:
+        require(key not in result, "duplicate JSON key: " + key)
+        result[key] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def decode(data):
+    require(len(data) <= MAX_JSON, "JSON exceeds bound")
+    return json.loads(data, object_pairs_hook=unique,
+                      parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(Refusal("nonfinite JSON")))
+
+
+def regular(path, limit=MAX_JSON):
+    path = Path(path)
+    require(stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), "expected regular file: " + str(path))
+    require(path.stat().st_size <= limit, "file exceeds bound: " + str(path))
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def document(path):
+    return decode(regular(path))
+
+
+def fields(obj, expected, label):
+    require(isinstance(obj, dict) and set(obj) == set(expected), label + " fields differ")
+
+
+def digest(value):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value), "invalid SHA256")
+    return value
+
+
+def commit(value):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", value), "invalid commit")
+    return value
+
+
+def version(value):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", value), "invalid version")
+    return value
+
+
+def safe_path(value):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\\" not in value and "\x00" not in value,
+            "invalid relative path")
+    p = PurePosixPath(value)
+    require(not p.is_absolute() and all(x not in ("", ".", "..") for x in value.split("/")),
+            "unsafe relative path")
+    return p
+
+
+def write_json(path, obj):
+    Path(path).write_bytes(canonical(obj))
+
+
+def run(args, *, env=None, cwd=ROOT, log=None, timeout=600):
+    """Bound local command output; overflow is failure, never a truncated PASS."""
+    stdout, stderr = bytearray(), bytearray()
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    with (Path(log).open("wb") if log is not None else contextlib.nullcontext()) as record:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(list(map(str, args)), cwd=cwd, env=env, start_new_session=True,
+                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        completed = False
+        try:
+            with selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector:
+                selector.register(process.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ, stdout)
+                selector.register(process.stderr, selectors.EVENT_READ, stderr)
+                while selector.get_map():
+                    require(time.monotonic() < deadline, "command exceeded time bound: " + str(args[0]))
+                    for key, _ in selector.select(min(1, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))):
+                        data = os.read(key.fileobj.fileno(), 65536)
+                        if not data:
+                            selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
+                            continue
+                        room = MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT - len(stdout) - len(stderr)
+                        if record is not None:
+                            record.write(data[:room])
+                        require(len(data) <= room, "command output exceeded bound: " + str(args[0]))
+                        key.data.extend(data)
+            process.wait(timeout=max(0.1, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+            require(process.returncode == 0, "command failed: " + str(args[0]) + " " + str(args[1])
+                    + "\n" + stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-4000:])
+            completed = True
+        finally:
+            if not completed:
+                # A child can inherit stdout after its parent exits. Kill this
+                # command's private session even in that case on timeout.
+                try:
+                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                except ProcessLookupError:
+                    pass
+                process.wait(timeout=5)
+            process.stdout.close()
+            process.stderr.close()
+    return bytes(stdout)
+
+
+def pins():
+    p = document(ROOT / "scripts/release/inputs.json")
+    fields(p, ("schema", "tools", "buildkit", "sbom_generator", "trust_selection", "signing_config", "extension"), "inputs")
+    require(p["schema"] == 1, "unsupported inputs schema")
+    return p
+
+
+def tool(name):
+    record = pins()["tools"][name]
+    filename = "trusted-root.json" if name == "trusted-root" else name
+    path = TOOLS / filename
+    data = regular(path, 256 * 1024**2)
+    expected = record["installed_sha256"]
+    if expected is None:
+        # An archive hash is the upstream assertion. Re-derive the member from
+        # those verified bytes; a locally writable receipt is not authority.
+        archive = regular(TOOLS / (name + ".download"), 256 * 1024**2)
+        require(len(archive) == record["size"] and sha(archive) == record["sha256"], "tool archive changed")
+        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive), mode="r:gz") as tf:
+            entries = [m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.name == record["member"]]
+            require(len(entries) == 1 and entries[0].isfile(), "invalid tool archive member")
+            require(entries[0].size <= 256 * 1024**2, "tool member exceeds bound")
+            expected = sha(tf.extractfile(entries[0]).read())
+    require(sha(data) == digest(expected), "pinned tool changed: " + name)
+    return path
+
+
+def image_map(images):
+    fields(images, SERVICES, "images")
+    for service, repo in SERVICES.items():
+        require(isinstance(images[service], str) and re.fullmatch(
+            r"ghcr\.io/zcat-app/" + repo + r"@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", images[service]),
+            "image is not the approved registry digest: " + service)
+    return images
+
+
+def compose(images):
+    image_map(images)
+    parser = tool("docker-compose")
+    clean = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
+             if not k.startswith(("STARGATE_", "COMPOSE_", "DOCKER_"))}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stargate-compose-") as directory:
+        empty = Path(directory) / "empty.env"
+        empty.touch()
+        base = [parser, "-p", "stargate", "--env-file", empty, "-f"]
+        flags = ["config", "--format", "json", "--no-interpolate", "--no-normalize",
+                 "--no-path-resolution", "--no-env-resolution"]
+        obj = decode(run([*base, ROOT / "compose/docker-compose.local.yml", *flags], env=clean))
+        require(isinstance(obj, dict) and isinstance(obj.get("services"), dict), "invalid source Compose")
+        fields(obj["services"], SERVICES, "Compose services")
+        for name, service in obj["services"].items():
+            for mount in service.get("volumes", []):
+                if isinstance(mount, str):
+                    source = mount.split(":", 1)[0]
+                    require(not source.startswith((".", "~")), "relative bind is unsupported")
+                elif isinstance(mount, dict) and mount.get("type") == "bind":
+                    require(str(mount.get("source", "")).startswith("/"), "relative bind is unsupported")
+            service["image"] = images[name]
+            service.pop("build", None)
+            if service.get("pull_policy") == "build":
+                del service["pull_policy"]
+        output = Path(directory) / "compose.json"
+        write_json(output, obj)
+        require(decode(run([*base, output, *flags], env=clean)) == obj, "Compose round trip differs")
+    return obj
+

+def source_identity(source, tag):
+    commit(source)
+    version(tag)
+    require(run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]).decode().strip() == source, "HEAD is not source C")
+    require(run(["git", "rev-parse", "--verify", "refs/tags/" + tag + "^{commit}"]).decode().strip() == source,
+            "existing version tag is not source C")
+    require(not run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=normal"]).strip(), "source checkout is dirty")
+    require(not run(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "scripts", "compose", ".github"]).strip(),
+            "untracked source file")
+    result = {}
+    for row in run(["git", "ls-tree", "-rz", "--full-tree", source]).split(b"\0"):
+        if not row:
+            continue
+        header, name = row.split(b"\t", 1)
+        mode, kind, oid = header.decode().split()
+        require(mode in ("100644", "100755") and kind == "blob", "source symlink/submodule is unsupported")
+        relative = name.decode()
+        safe_path(relative)
+        require((ROOT / relative).resolve(strict=True) == ROOT / relative,
+                "source path traverses a substituted symlink: " + relative)
+        data = regular(ROOT / relative, MAX_ARCHIVE)
+        actual_mode = "100755" if (ROOT / relative).stat().st_mode & 0o111 else "100644"
+        require(actual_mode == mode, "source executable mode differs from C: " + relative)
+        # Git's path clean filter authenticates checkout bytes against C.
+        # Git archive exports CRLF for required CRLF paths, so the retained
+        # manifest binds the delivered checkout/archive bytes (Principle IV).
+        actual = run(["git", "hash-object", "--path=" + relative, "--", relative]).decode().strip()
+        require(actual == oid, "source bytes differ from C: " + relative)
+        result[relative] = {"sha256": sha(data), "mode": mode}
+    require(result, "empty source manifest")
+    return result
+
+
+def verify_install(directory, output=None):
+    directory = Path(directory).resolve(strict=True)
+    manifest_path = directory / "release.json"
+    manifest_data = regular(manifest_path)
+    manifest = decode(manifest_data)
+    fields(manifest, ("schema", "version", "source", "platform", "images", "compose_sha256",
+                      "source_files", "artifacts", "pack_sha256"), "release manifest")
+    require(manifest["schema"] == 1 and manifest["platform"] == "linux/amd64", "unsupported release")
+    version(manifest["version"])
+    commit(manifest["source"])
+    digest(manifest["pack_sha256"])
+    image_map(manifest["images"])
+    expected_source = source_identity(manifest["source"], manifest["version"])
+    require(manifest["source_files"] == expected_source, "release source-file identity differs")
+    bundle = directory / "release.sigstore.json"
+    bundle_data = regular(bundle)
+    # The source-owned root and exact workflow identity are never taken from
+    # the release document. Cosign supplies cryptographic/time/log validation.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stargate-signature-") as temporary:
+        snapshot = Path(temporary)
+        (snapshot / "release.json").write_bytes(manifest_data)
+        (snapshot / "bundle.json").write_bytes(bundle_data)
+        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("COSIGN_", "SIGSTORE_"))}
+        run([tool("cosign"), "verify-blob", "--bundle", snapshot / "bundle.json",
+             *signature_flags(manifest["source"], manifest["version"]), snapshot / "release.json"], env=env)
+    compose_path = directory / "compose.json"
+    data = regular(compose_path)
+    require(sha(data) == digest(manifest["compose_sha256"]), "release Compose hash differs")
+    require(decode(data) == compose(manifest["images"]), "release Compose topology differs from source")
+    if output is not None:
+        # The installer uses these already-validated bytes from a private
+        # directory, never reopens the untrusted input after verification.
+        with Path(output).open("xb") as stream:
+            stream.write(data)
+        return Path(output).resolve()
+    return compose_path
+
+
+def inventory(directory):
+    result = {}
+    for path in sorted(Path(directory).rglob("*")):
+        require(not path.is_symlink(), "symlink in data directory")
+        if path.is_dir():
+            continue
+        require(stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), "nonregular artifact")
+        result[path.relative_to(directory).as_posix()] = {"sha256": file_hash(path), "size": path.stat().st_size}
+    return result
+
+
+def check_inventory(directory, expected, *, excluded=()):
+    require(isinstance(expected, dict) and expected, "empty artifact inventory")
+    for name, record in expected.items():
+        safe_path(name)
+        fields(record, ("sha256", "size"), "file record")
+        digest(record["sha256"])
+        require(type(record["size"]) is int and 0 <= record["size"] <= MAX_UNPACKED, "invalid file size")
+    actual = inventory(directory)
+    for name in excluded:
+        actual.pop(name, None)
+    require(actual == expected, "file inventory differs")
+
+
+def check_evidence(candidate_path, directory):
+    candidate_data = regular(candidate_path)
+    candidate = decode(candidate_data)
+    source, tag = commit(candidate["source"]), version(candidate["version"])
+    directory = Path(directory)
+    index = document(directory / "index.json")
+    fields(index, ("schema", "source", "version", "candidate_sha256", "files"), "evidence index")
+    require(index["schema"] == 1 and index["source"] == source and index["version"] == tag
+            and index["candidate_sha256"] == sha(candidate_data), "evidence candidate is stale")
+    require(len(index["files"]) <= 128 and sum(r["size"] for r in index["files"].values()) <= 64 * 1024**2,
+            "evidence exceeds bound")
+    check_inventory(directory, index["files"], excluded=("index.json",))
+
+    def report_body(name):
+        safe_path(name)
+        require(name in index["files"] and not name.endswith(".json"), "missing full report body")
+        require(regular(directory / name).strip(), "empty report body")
+
+    for name in ("T078", "T079", "external-human"):
+        report = document(directory / (name + ".json"))
+        fields(report, ("schema", "source", "status", "reviewer", "observed_at", "report", "independent", "human"), name)
+        require(report["schema"] == 1 and report["source"] == source and report["status"] == "PASS", name + " not passed on C")
+        require(report["independent"] is True and isinstance(report["reviewer"], str)
+                and report["reviewer"].strip(), name + " reviewer provenance absent")
+        require(type(report["human"]) is bool and (name != "external-human" or report["human"]), "external human review absent")
+        require(timestamp(report["observed_at"]) <= now(), "review timestamp is in the future")
+        report_body(report["report"])
+    live = document(directory / "live.json")
+    fields(live, ("schema", "source", "version", "tracker_sha256", "observations"), "live report")
+    tracker = regular(ROOT / "specs/001-tor-route/live-e2e/README.md")
+    require(live["schema"] == 1 and live["source"] == source and live["version"] == tag
+            and live["tracker_sha256"] == sha(tracker), "live tracker/source changed")
+    rows = {line.split("|")[1].strip(): sha(line.encode()) for line in tracker.decode().splitlines()
+            if line.startswith(("| F", "| R-"))}
+    required = ["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F7", *["R-" + str(i) for i in range(1, 9)]]
+    fields(live["observations"], required, "live observations")
+    artifacts = {k: v["sha256"] for k, v in candidate["artifacts"].items()}
+    for name in required:
+        observation = live["observations"][name]
+        keys = ["status", "scope", "report", "contract_sha256", "artifact_sha256"]
+        fields(observation, keys + (["coverage"] if name == "R-7" else []), name)
+        require(observation["status"] == "PASS" and observation["scope"] == "exercised", name + " not exercised")
+        require(observation["contract_sha256"] == rows[name], name + " contract differs")
+        require(observation["artifact_sha256"] == artifacts, name + " artifacts differ")
+        report_body(observation["report"])
+        if name == "R-7":
+            fields(observation["coverage"], ("routed-ipv6", "lan", "vps", "physical-nic", "hypervisor"), "R-7 coverage")
+            require(all(v == "PASS" for v in observation["coverage"].values()), "R-7 scope is unmeasured")
+    pending = [r["check"] for r in candidate.get("pending", []) if r["evidence"] == "cadence"]
+    if pending:
+        cadence = document(directory / "cadence.json")
+        fields(cadence, ("schema", "source", "artifact_sha256", "results"), "cadence report")
+        require(cadence["schema"] == 1 and cadence["source"] == source and cadence["artifact_sha256"] == artifacts,
+                "cadence evidence source/artifacts differ")
+        fields(cadence["results"], pending, "cadence results")
+        for name, result in cadence["results"].items():
+            fields(result, ("status", "report"), "cadence result")
+            require(result["status"] == "PASS", "cadence suite not executed: " + name)
+            report_body(result["report"])
+    # These structural checks bind complete bytes, not an author's identity or
+    # honesty. The protected approver must inspect provenance and full reports.
+    return sha(canonical(index))
+
+
+def timestamp(value):
+    require(isinstance(value, str) and value.endswith("Z"), "timestamp must be UTC")
+    result = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value[:-1] + "+00:00")
+    require(result.tzinfo is not None, "timestamp lacks timezone")
+    return result
+
+
+def now():
+    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+
+
+def fresh_trust():
+    policy = pins()
+    selection = policy["trust_selection"]
+    fields(selection, ("target_sha256", "target_length", "fresh_until", "bootstrap", "metadata"), "trust selection")
+    root = policy["tools"]["trusted-root"]
+    require(selection["target_sha256"] == root["sha256"] and selection["target_length"] == root["size"],
+            "trust selection target differs")
+    fields(selection["metadata"], ("15.root.json", "targets.json", "snapshot.json", "timestamp.json"), "trust metadata")
+    for record in selection["metadata"].values():
+        fields(record, ("version", "sha256", "size"), "trust metadata record")
+        digest(record["sha256"])
+        require(type(record["version"]) is int and record["version"] > 0
+                and type(record["size"]) is int and record["size"] > 0, "malformed trust selection")
+    require(now() < timestamp(selection["fresh_until"]), "trust selection is stale; reviewed source refresh required")
+    tool("trusted-root")
+
+
+def checked_signing_config():
+    # Cosign v3 selects signing services from a file. Pin that file to C and
+    # the same freshness cutoff as the reviewed trust root (Principle IV).
+    policy = pins()
+    config = policy["signing_config"]
+    fields(config, ("mediaType", "caUrls", "rekorTlogUrls", "rekorTlogConfig", "tsaConfig"), "signing config")
+    interval = {"start": "2026-10-11T00:00:00Z", "end": policy["trust_selection"]["fresh_until"]}
+    require(timestamp(interval["start"]) <= now() < timestamp(interval["end"]), "signing service selection is stale")
+    service = {"majorApiVersion": 1, "validFor": interval, "operator": "sigstore.dev"}
+    require(config == {"mediaType": "application/vnd.dev.sigstore.signingconfig.v0.2+json",
+                       "caUrls": [service | {"url": "https://fulcio.sigstore.dev"}],
+                       "rekorTlogUrls": [service | {"url": "https://rekor.sigstore.dev"}],
+                       "rekorTlogConfig": {"selector": "EXACT", "count": 1}, "tsaConfig": {}},
+            "signing config differs from fixed Fulcio/Rekor service policy")
+    return config
+
+
+def api(path, *, method="GET", data=None, with_link=False):
+    require(path == "" or path.startswith("/") and not path.startswith("//"), "invalid API path")
+    token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
+    require(token and os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY") == REPOSITORY, "canonical repository token/context required")
+    headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
+               "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    request = urllib.request.Request(API + path, data=None if data is None else canonical(data),
+                                     headers=headers, method=method)
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
+        result = decode(response.read(MAX_JSON + 1))
+        return (result, response.headers.get("Link")) if with_link else result
+
